title: 第18章 归来第19章 惊雷
content_zh:
陆沉低语，不由泛起几分笑意。
他很清楚，这并非他天资惊人，而是两种劲力在不断交锋中缓缓适应，最后成功逐渐彼此互相共存。
这也只有陆沉能做到了，换成普通人敢这么做，早就已经彻底废掉了。
哪怕是化境武人，也不能轻易降服两种功法的劲力。
“短短三天，我的力量和防御力增长了至少八成，反应能力也有所提升，再遇到那黑鳞狼，最三招便可将其一击毙命。”
陆沉沉吟着，又看向了逐渐化掉的积雪，不由动了几分离去的念头。
“朱果药力已耗尽，积雪也开始化开。”
“我不能再继续等下去了，先去找找楚阔师兄他们，若是寻不到就独自回去。”
陆沉做出决定，又回头将黑鳞狼的尸骨拖了出来。
这黑鳞狼生前重达三百斤，抛开内脏骨骼等器官还有一百多斤，这几天陆沉跟二黑将其内脏已经吃的差不多了。
剩下的都是好肉，若是拿出去卖至少能卖出两百两纹银。
陆沉准备带回去，作为接下来一段时间的修行资粮，反正这凉国的天气也不怕坏掉。
扛起黑鳞狼，陆沉一路往黑狼岭而去，一路来到了黑狼谷却没有找到楚阔等人。
没办法，他只好扛起黑鳞狼离去，一路走了一整天才离开大寒山。
直到他回到家的时候，才发现家里传来一阵哭声，门口还挂着一些白布。
“家里死人了？”
陆沉心中一惊，连忙快步走进屋子。
眼看屋里正坐着不少人，陆恒阳更是满脸愁容的立在火盆前，他顿时放下黑鳞狼问道：“爹，家里出了什么事？”
“鬼啊！”
屋里的人愣了一下，等到看清陆沉才面色骇然的道。

一阵鸡飞狗跳之后，陆沉总算明白了前因后果。
原来自从陆沉被黑鳞狼追走后，林武很快就支援了过来，他们将那两头黑鳞狼斩杀，随后就开始搜寻陆沉的踪迹。
结果搜了两天，还没有找到陆沉的踪迹，于是他们断定陆沉不可能在那黑鳞狼的追击下活下来。
又死了几个人，再加上收获已经不小，几人也就没有再多留，回来把事情告诉了沈衡。
沈衡知道情况以后，给陆沉送来了五十两银子的抚恤。
就连楚阔都额外送了三十两银子过来，这让陆家更加确定陆沉已经死了，所以这是给陆沉办丧事呢。
“合着吃上自己的席了。”
陆沉无奈摇头，伸手道：“把抚恤银子给我，我去找沈师一趟。”
拿起银子，陆沉一路往沈氏武馆而去。
而这一次，沈氏武馆的众人也是一阵吃惊，前天才得到陆沉战死的消息，想不到今天陆沉就活着回来了。
沈衡为此亲自召见他，似乎注意到他旺盛的气血，一开口就询问道：“你机缘不小。”
“弟子这次机缘不错，意外找到了一颗宝果。”
陆沉开口，交还五十两抚恤，又把朱果的消息告知了沈衡。
不过他把过程颠倒了一下，改成自己意外遇到了朱果，服用之后突破明劲，最后仗着兵器之力杀了那头黑鳞狼。
content_en:
Lu Chen whispered, unable to help but smile a little.
He knows very well that this is not because of his amazing talent, but because the two forces slowly adapt to each other in the constant confrontation, and finally succeed in coexisting with each other.
Only Lu Chen can do this. If an ordinary person dared to do this, it would have been completely destroyed long ago.
Even a martial artist in the Transformation Realm cannot easily surrender to the power of the two techniques.
"In just three days, my strength and defense have increased by at least 80%, and my reaction ability has also improved. If I encounter the black-scaled wolf again, I can kill it with just three moves."
Lu Chen pondered, then looked at the gradually melting snow, and couldn't help but think about leaving.
"The red fruit medicine has been exhausted, and the snow has begun to melt."
"I can't wait any longer. I'll look for Senior Brother Chu Kuo and the others first. If I can't find them, I'll go back alone."
Lu Chen made a decision and turned back to drag out the black-scaled wolf's body.
This black-scaled wolf weighed three hundred kilograms before it was alive, and weighed more than a hundred kilograms apart from its internal organs, bones and other organs. In the past few days, Lu Chen and Er Hei had eaten almost all of its internal organs.
The rest is all good meat, and if sold, it would fetch at least two hundred taels of silver.
Lu Chen planned to take it back with him to use as training materials for the next period of time. Anyway, the weather in Liang Kingdom was not afraid of spoiling.
Carrying the Black Scale Wolf, Lu Chen headed all the way to Black Wolf Ridge. He arrived at Black Wolf Valley but did not find Chu Kuo and others.
He had no choice but to pick up the black-scaled wolf and leave. He walked all day long before leaving Dahan Mountain.
It wasn't until he got home that he noticed a cry coming from the house and some white cloth hanging at the door.
"Is there a death in the family?"
Lu Chen was shocked and quickly walked into the house.
Seeing that there were many people sitting in the room, Lu Hengyang stood in front of the brazier with a sad face. He immediately put down the black-scaled wolf and asked: "Dad, what happened at home?"
"Ghost!"
The people in the room were stunned for a moment, and then they said with a horrified expression when they saw Lu Chen clearly.
After a moment of confusion, Lu Chen finally understood the cause and effect.
It turned out that since Lu Chen was chased away by the black-scaled wolves, Lin Wu quickly came to support him. They killed the two black-scaled wolves, and then began to search for traces of Lu Chen.
After searching for two days, no trace of Lu Chen was found, so they concluded that Lu Chen would not survive the pursuit of the black-scaled wolf.
A few more people died, and the harvest was already considerable, so they didn't stay any longer and came back to tell Shen Heng what happened.
After Shen Heng learned about the situation, he sent Lu Chen a pension of fifty taels of silver.
Even Chu Kuo sent an extra thirty taels of silver, which made the Lu family more certain that Lu Chen was dead, so this was a funeral for Lu Chen.
"Let's eat together at our own table."
Lu Chen shook his head helplessly, stretched out his hand and said, "Give me the pension money, and I'll go find Master Shen."
Picking up the silver, Lu Chen headed all the way to Shen's martial arts gym.
But this time, everyone in the Shen Family Martial Arts Hall was also shocked. They only received the news of Lu Chen's death in battle the day before yesterday. They did not expect that Lu Chen would come back alive today.
Shen Heng personally summoned him for this purpose. He seemed to notice his strong energy and blood, and asked as soon as he opened his mouth: "You have a good chance."
"This disciple had a good chance and unexpectedly found a treasure fruit."
Lu Chen spoke up, returned the fifty taels of pension, and informed Shen Heng of Zhu Guo's news.
However, he reversed the process and changed it to a situation where he accidentally encountered Zhu Guo, took it and broke through Ming Jin, and finally killed the black-scaled wolf with the power of the weapon.
